purpose: Engineer the system around the model - context, tools, control loop, verification, observability and feedback - so agents (Claude Code, Codex and generated project agents) act reliably, and every capability is proven by a reproducible eval harness.

harness_layers.coding_agent_harness: How Claude Code and Codex operate this repository: instruction maps, permissions, hooks, validation commands and shared memory.
harness_layers.agent_runtime_harness: How agents inside a generated solution run: tool gateway, budgets, stop conditions, approval gates, traces.
harness_layers.eval_harness: How any capability is proven: versioned cases, graders, repeated trials, gates and CI.

components.goal: Agents find the rules and the map of the repository without reading everything.
Least-privilege tools with explicit allowed, approval-required and forbidden actions.
Budgets and stop conditions bound every agent run.
Deterministic tests and evals decide completion, not the model's own claim.
Tool-using behavior has its own cases (right tool, right arguments, approval respected).
Every runtime agent of the solution has a validated blueprint: objective, tools, authority, model tier, budget, evals and escalation.
Every run leaves a trace: model, prompt version, tools, tokens, latency, outcome.
Failures and approved examples become new eval cases and memory, never silent weight updates.
Side effects are simulated first, idempotent, reversible or approval-gated.

eval_harness.grader_rule: Use the cheapest grader that can decide; model-graded checks need a written rubric and periodic human agreement checks.

metrics.pass_at_k: probability that at least one of k trials succeeds (capability)
metrics.pass_hat_k: probability that all k trials succeed (reliability)

eval_harness.flaky_case_policy: quarantine with an owner and a fix-by date; never delete a failing case to go green
eval_harness.ci_rule: Deterministic suites run on every change; model-backed suites run before release.

mechanical_enforcement: structural contract tests guard architecture and generated-project boundaries
every referenced repository path must exist or be declared as generated/runtime
validation scripts fail loudly instead of warning
readiness_rule: A project is harness-ready when every component that applies to its universe has its evidence present.

governance.source: migrated from the former agent trust framework
